description:
Survey harness crates under `dev/` declare Cargo path dependencies relative to their own directory, the named exception `harness-path-dependencies` to `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`. The exception ends when the harness crates resolve those dependencies independently of their depth.

## Background

On Rust 1.95 a `[patch]` table in the repository `.cargo/config.toml` adds `[[patch.unused]]` entries to every lockfile whose graph lacks a patched package, and those graphs then fail under `--locked`. The exception record linked to the documentation-overhaul epic holds the trials.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each survey harness crate builds from its location and from a copy one directory level deeper with no manifest change.
- [hard] REQ-02: The root lockfile and every tracked harness lockfile resolve under `--locked`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The benchmark-acceptance verdict of every committed `zen3-benchmark-receipt-v1` receipt is identical before and after the change.
- [hard] REQ-04: The exception record is removed or states that the exception has ended.
title: Converge survey harness path dependencies on a depth-independent form
